components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Mosque-green pill button, the system's default call to action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: hsl(168 68% 17%); color: hsl(42 30% 97%); border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(38 37 33 / 0.04); transition: transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(37 91% 55%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Brass-filled pill button for lower-frequency actions (export, save).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: hsl(38 45% 42%); color: hsl(42 30% 97%); border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: hsl(40 55% 58%); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(37 91% 55%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: Borderless, soft-shadow default container for list items, results, and panels.
components.css: .ds-surface-card { background: hsl(42 30% 97%); border-radius: 1.3125rem; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -8px rgb(38 37 33 / 0.10), 0 2px 6px -2px rgb(38 37 33 / 0.05); padding: 1.5rem; transition: transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-surface-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.125rem; color: hsl(60 6% 15%); margin: 0 0 0.25rem; } .ds-card-body { font-weight: 300; font-size: 0.875rem; color: hsl(60 6% 15% / 0.6); margin: 0; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Pill-radius search input embedded in a soft-elevation shell with icon and submit button.
components.html: <form class="ds-search-field"><svg class="ds-search-icon" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"/></svg><input class="ds-search-input" placeholder="ابحث في المتن، الراوي، أو الكتاب..." /><button class="ds-search-submit" type="submit">ابحث</button></form>
components.css: .ds-search-field { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: hsl(42 30% 97%); border-radius: 1.3125rem; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -8px rgb(38 37 33 / 0.10); padding: 0.5rem; max-width: 36rem; } .ds-search-icon { color: hsl(60 6% 15% / 0.35); margin: 0 0.75rem; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-search-input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; font-size: 1rem; color: hsl(60 6% 15%); } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: hsl(60 6% 15% / 0.35); } .ds-search-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(37 91% 55%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-search-submit { flex-shrink: 0; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(168 68% 17%); color: hsl(42 30% 97%); padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; }

components.name: Metadata Badge

narrative.overview: King Sunnah is built as a single confident editorial product: one idea per viewport, huge quiet typography, and generous whitespace, in the register the user named directly ("modern, elegant, like Apple website"). It replaces two things explicitly rejected in this project's history: the original generic shadcn dashboard, and this project's own first redesign — the "Complex Wayfinding" world of stone-and-brass hall signage, carved Reem Kufi display type, square brass avatar tiles, and a fixed dark hall-directory sidebar. The shipped system keeps the project's original HSL color tokens verbatim but recasts their role entirely: stone and charcoal carry nearly every screen, and mosque-green, brass, and amber each get exactly one deliberate, non-repeating job rather than being sprinkled as decoration. Depth comes from real soft shadows on borderless cards, not from hairline borders. Corners are generous and soft everywhere, with full-pill radius on every interactive control. A sticky, blurred, translucent glass header replaces the old fixed sidebar entirely.
keyCharacteristics: One enormous, Thin-weight headline per key viewport; type carries the drama, not color or ornament
Amber (--signal) reserved for exactly one live/aggregate numeral per view — never decorative, never repeated
Soft-elevation, borderless cards (real offset+blur shadow) as the default container, replacing the old flat hairline plaque
Full-pill radius on every interactive control; generous ~21px radius on static containers
Sticky translucent/blurred glass navigation, not a fixed sidebar
IBM Plex Sans Arabic exclusively, self-hosted Thin(100)-Bold(700), with large headlines running Thin/ExtraLight
Neutral, non-color-coded avatars and metadata badges — no per-item accent coding anywhere in a listing

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber appears on exactly one live/aggregate numeral per view — never more than once, never on a static or per-item count.

rules.name: The Neutral Item Rule
rules.body: Individual items inside any listing never carry their own accent color; color marks state, never per-item identity.

rules.name: The Stamped Grade Rule
rules.body: "صحيح" alone gets the verification-seal green fill + check-shield glyph; every other grade renders as the same plain neutral badge as surrounding metadata.

rules.name: The Thin Headline Rule
rules.body: Large per-viewport headlines run Thin (100) or Light (300) weight, never Bold or SemiBold.

rules.name: The Tabular Numeral Rule
rules.body: Any live or comparative numeral uses tabular-nums so digits don't jitter or reflow.

rules.name: The Borderless-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A container's depth comes from shadow, not from a border; hairline borders are a minor exception, never the default.

dos: Do use .surface-card (borderless, soft shadow, ~21px radius) as the default container for any new panel or list item.
Do reserve amber (--signal) for exactly one live/aggregate numeral per view; every other number is plain charcoal or the state color it already carries.
Do render every interactive control at full pill radius (rounded-full), even though the underlying shadcn Button defaults to rounded-md.
Do keep avatars, initials, and per-item metadata badges neutrally tinted and identical across every item in a listing.
Do render the "صحيح" grade as the one filled/colored badge; every other grade value uses the same plain neutral badge as surrounding metadata.
Do author top-level destination lists as a divided plain-text list with a sticky heading column, per the Editorial Link List pattern.
donts: Don't reintroduce Reem Kufi or any separate carved/monumental display face — IBM Plex Sans Arabic (Thin-Bold) is the sole family.
Don't reintroduce the near-square 2-7px radius or square brass-bordered avatar tiles from the prior Complex Wayfinding world.
Don't use a hairline border as a container's primary depth device — shadow is the default.
Don't give individual listing items their own accent color or icon-in-colored-circle treatment — this shipped once and was corrected; it does not come back.
Don't repeat the amber signal treatment more than once per view, or apply it to a static/non-live number.
Don't add a kicker/eyebrow label above a heading; the Thin-weight headline carries its own weight.
